description: Complete trace of workspace switch workflow from UI event to persistence

sequence.action: User clicks workspace dropdown item, triggering handleWorkspaceSwitch with target workspace
Platform validation - check if IDE access is allowed on current device (mobile/tablet blocked)
Coordinate state updates across all stores using singleton manager
Update workspace store state, set isTransitioning=true, emit cross-workspace event
Broadcast workspace change event to all subscribed listeners
Select appropriate agent for new workspace based on persisted lastSelectedAgentId
React effect listener that calls selectAgentForWorkspace when workspace changes
Navigate to new workspace route using TanStack Router
Persist last workspace to localStorage, emit cross-workspace event, navigate via useNavigate
Route loader waits for hydration, queries Dexie for project, sets up ProjectProvider
Persist currentWorkspace to Dexie via createDexieStorage('providerConfigs')
Write workspace state to IndexedDB providerConfigs table with quota management

side_effects.description: When switching workspaces, current agent may not be available in new workspace. AgentSelectionStore selects appropriate agent based on workspace bindings and lastSelectedAgentId
Event bus emits 'workspace:changed' event with from/to workspace and timestamp. All subscribed components react to this event
Current workspace is persisted to localStorage key 'project_{projectId}_last_workspace' for auto-restore on next project open
Zustand persist middleware writes currentWorkspace to Dexie 'providerConfigs' table via createDexieStorage
TanStack Router navigates to new route pattern '/{workspace}/$projectId', triggering route loader and component mount
When project changes, FSA handle is cleared to prevent stale handle reuse
IDE workspace is blocked on mobile/tablet devices. Platform contract checks canAccessIDE before allowing switch
isTransitioning flag set to true, transitionFrom set to previous workspace, 300ms timeout clears transition state

invariant_assumptions.assumption: Project must be loaded before workspace switch
Target workspace must be enabled for project
At least one agent must be available in target workspace
Store hydration complete before route loader
invariant_assumptions.enforced_by: waitForHydration() in route loaders ensures Zustand stores are hydrated

invariant_assumptions.assumption: Dexie database is open before persistence

failure_points.condition: User on mobile/tablet attempts to switch to IDE workspace
failure_points.result: Switch is blocked, console warning logged, user stays in current workspace
Switch blocked with warning, navigation does not occur

failure_points.condition: project?.id is null when switchWorkspace called
failure_points.result: Switch blocked with warning, no navigation

failure_points.point: No agents available in target workspace
failure_points.result: Transition validation fails, error returned, switch does not proceed
Switch blocked with warning, returns early without navigation

failure_points.condition: IndexedDB storage is full when persisting workspace state
failure_points.result: evictOldestEntries() runs to free space, retry once, throw if still fails
Error caught and logged, switch state may be inconsistent
Error not caught, may crash event bus or leave state inconsistent
